title: Business Earning Basis of a Line with Refunds or Returns
content:
**Rule.** Under the Business earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the Business earning basis of the line the schedule settles counts only the merchandise the business kept, read from the line's records on Northgate Store and Online Orders: the line (its net amount and the units bought), the refunds made on it without a return (the units they cover) and the returns made on it (the merchandise they refunded).

- **Units refunded without a return, none returned:** the Business earning basis is the net amount multiplied by the units kept (the units bought less the units so refunded), divided by the units bought, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Units returned, none refunded without a return:** it is the net amount less the merchandise refunded on those returns.
- **Both:** it is the net amount multiplied by the units bought less the units refunded without a return, divided by the units bought, rounded half up to the cent, and then less the merchandise refunded on the returns.
- **Neither:** no reduction applies.

The net amount is the amount paid for the line after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount, before tax, fees, gift cards and Northgate Cash.

**Worked cases (hypothetical line of 8 units, net amount 400.00)**

| Records on the line | Business earning basis |
|---|---|
| 2 units refunded without a return | 400.00 multiplied by 6, divided by 8, that is 300.00 |
| a return refunding 75.00 | 400.00 less 75.00, that is 325.00 |
| 2 units refunded without a return and a return refunding 75.00 | 300.00 less 75.00, that is 225.00 |
